history.name: One canonical shape for every file
history.description: Every write leaves the record formatted the same way, with the same field order. Editing one feature therefore shows up in the project's version history as that one edit, rather than as a whole file reshuffled by whichever tool happened to write it.
history.dev_notes: writeJson() in src/util.mjs (2-space indent, trailing newline) plus Feature#toJSON()'s fixed key order.
